description: Ferry sailings from one port to another on a day, with times and, for today, live status (on time, departed, cancelled) and service alerts such as typhoon suspensions. Example: from "富岡", to "綠島"; or from "馬公", to "七美", city "PenghuCounty".

after.description: Only departures at or after this time, HH:mm (default: now for today, else 00:00).

city.description: Leave out for the nationwide ferries (outlying islands, 小三通). For lines run by a county or city, its code: PenghuCounty, Kaohsiung, NewTaipei, Taipei, KinmenCounty (Penghu inter-island boats, 旗津 ferry, 淡水 blue highway, 金門 local ferries).

date.description: Travel date in Taiwan, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today).

from.description: Departure port: name (綠島, 富岡, 小琉球, 基隆, 南竿) or port ID (TWGNI).

limit.description: Maximum number of sailings to return (default 20).

to.description: Arrival port: name (綠島, 富岡, 小琉球, 基隆, 南竿) or port ID (TWGNI).

name: ferry_timetable
title: Ferry timetable
